title: Vibenta thematic coverage plan: food x music x vibe
notes: These are semantic categories, NOT individual 3D assets. 'strong_candidates' means identified source packs with plausible matching assets; it does not mean items have been downloaded or inspected.
The 12 already imported KayKit models are generic dining and haunted props. No newly sourced packs in this plan have been downloaded.
Food, music genre, aesthetic mood, venue type and occasion are independent; combinations should be resolved at object level without inferring unverifiable venue conditions.
Separate licensed scene assets from venue facts. Don't claim decorative objects, music performances or food dishes exist at a real location.

coverageVocabulary.partial: some props/source packs identified but key motifs missing

compositionRules.selection: Choose hero for highest-confidence cuisine/genre-specific motifs; choose accent for compatible mood. If no specific motifs are verified, prefer generic tasteful decoration over incorrect cultural signals.
compositionRules.genreActivation: Only use music-genre objects when user requests that genre or verified venue context supports it; do not imply an event or performance is occurring.
compositionRules.cuisineActivation: Only use cuisine-specific motifs when user explicitly chooses it or verified venue data labels it; do not infer food availability from a vibe descriptor.
compositionRules.moodActivation: Use mood broadly for color/lighting and ambient accents; don't force a food/music genre from mood.
safety: max one hero plus one accent
positions never cover paths, transit stations, selected pins, road labels or attribution
focus mode may suppress all nonessential set pieces
never fabricate building geometry or venue facts

priorityGaps: Explicit prepared-food 3D for Chinese, Korean, Thai, Vietnamese, Greek and Ethiopian cuisines
Verified pasta, tacos, thali, mezze, pho, dim sum and Korean barbecue tabletop objects
Original disco ball/record player, low-fi room props and genre-appropriate music performance accents
Unified low-poly visual treatment, GLB conversion and perf budgets for sourced mixed-style packs
